T-3000: 1801 Prairie's hooded dormers, deck cresting and finials, and flank stack from the Taylor photograph (#1206)

* T-3000: 1801 Prairie's hooded dormers, deck cresting and finials, and flank stack from the Taylor photograph

K01 gains a hooded mansard dormer (head: hood — a short stone face under a
shelf, a tapered slated hood over it), a mansard deck dressing
(k01_mansard_deck.py: the K10 kit's iron cresting round the curb, turned
finials at its corners, a slated hood on a named corner) and a per-stack
cap on a mansard's plain stacks. Every other K01 house re-emits
byte-identical (31 restamped in the manifest). Read through T-2538's
camera; sections and patterns reconstructed
(L-kimball-1801-deck-cresting-3000). The curb's own offset from the print
is added to T-1890 as a finding.

T-3038: 1904 context city kept off the streets, the IC tracks and itself; First Presbyterian un-mirrored (#1215)

The context generator tested a projected stand-in's centre and corners against parcels and
blocks only, so one stood on 18th Street's curve into Calumet Avenue, faded streets lay in the
Illinois Central's tracks, sheds stacked inside each other and trees stood in roadways.

- clear_city(): every stand-in tested as its whole rectangle against the grid's carriageways,
  walks, parkways, curbs and alleys, the right of way (data/railway/1904_context.json) plus a
  3 m fence strip, the faded streets and every kept stand-in; cut back or dropped. Trees too.
- East of Calumet below its curve the lots run back to the right of way (Sanborn 1911 sheet 28
  at 20th Street); faded streets are cut by the right of way and end square to 0.1 m.
- Each projected block draws from its own seed.
- contract()/--self-test fail on every overlap, including the owner's exact case.
- draft_prairie_1904.site_record(): a west-fronted site's v figures are mirrored into the
  record's frame; First Presbyterian (T-3009) stood across 21st Street. Rebuilt.
- L-context-streets-2491 amended; before/after shots in docs/RESEARCH/context-clear-3038.
